body: **Foco:** Inverted hypothetical (Were I…) — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** transcrição de palestra e podcast.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar a hipótese invertida Were I / Were she / Were it not for em uma palestra sobre ética em pesquisa.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Lecture: Ethics in Research Design
paras: Good morning. **Were I** to design a study on stress, I would first ask whether participants can refuse. **Were it not for** informed consent, research on people **would be** indefensible. **Were participants** not protected, trust **would collapse**.
**Were she a reviewer**, she **would reject** any proposal that hides risks. In short, **were we to ignore** ethics, the data **would lose** its value.

items.q: Participants should be unable to refuse.

items.why: Were it not for informed consent.

items.q: Ignoring ethics would reduce the value of data.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **Were I to design a study, I would ask first.**
**Were participants not protected, trust would collapse.**
**Were it not for consent, research would be indefensible.**
**Were she a reviewer, she would reject it.**

blocks.body: A hipótese invertida expressa **situações irreais ou improváveis no presente/futuro**. Equivale a *If I were…*, mas é mais formal.
Use **were** para todas as pessoas, incluindo *I* e *she*.

items.s: ___ I to design a study, I would ask first. (Were)
Were it not ___ consent, research would be indefensible. (for)
Were participants not ___ , trust would collapse. (protected)
___ she a reviewer, she would reject it. (Were)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: Por que o consentimento é essencial?

body: **Above suspicion.** — Acima de suspeita.
**Cross the line.** — Passar dos limites.
**Err on the side of caution.** — Pecar pelo excesso de cautela.
**Informed decision.** — Decisão informada.
**Do no harm.** — Não causar dano.
**Keep it confidential.** — Manter em sigilo.
**Clear one’s name.** — Limpar o nome.
**On ethical grounds.** — Por razões éticas.
**Whether participants can refuse.** — Se os participantes podem recusar.
**Why is consent essential?** — Por que o consentimento é essencial?
**Were you to design a study, what would you ask first?** — Se você fosse projetar um estudo, o que perguntaria primeiro?

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Faça pausas curtas entre grupos de sentido (thought groups) e mantenha o ritmo: sílabas fortes em intervalos regulares, fracas comprimidas.
words: In my view, | the plan | is sound.
Having reviewed the data, | we agreed.

prompts.model: Were I to teach ethics, I’d start with consent.
Were it not for rules, chaos would reign.
Were she here, she would help.

blocks.task: Write six sentences with Were I… / Were it not for… about ethical rules in research.
blocks.model: Were I to design a study, I would ask first whether participants can refuse. Were it not for informed consent, research on people would be indefensible. Were participants not protected, trust would collapse. Were an ethics board absent, mistakes would go unnoticed. Were data to be shared without consent, harm would follow. Were we to ignore ethics, our results would lose value.
checklist: Usei **Were I / Were it not for**

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
